mapper.select:
SELECT t1.SRS_CD AS srs_cd , t1.STKPRC AS stkprc , t1.BLBG_TCKR AS blbg_tckr , t1.ISIN_CD AS isin_cd , t1.EXCH_CD AS exch_cd , t1.CRC_CD AS crc_cd , t1.EXPR_DATE AS expr_date , t1.GIJUN_STKPRC_YN AS gijun_stkprc_yn , t1.WEEK AS week FROM SRS_CD t1
t1.ISIN_CD LIKE '%' || #{isinCd} || '%'
ORDER BY t1.WEEK , t1.STKPRC

SELECT t1.corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.jm_cd , t1.jonga , t1.danga , TO_CHAR(t1.load_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS load_time , TO_CHAR(t1.px_close_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS px_close_dt , t1.px_last , TO_CHAR(t1.px_dt_1d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS px_dt_1d , t1.px_close_1d , t1.px_yest_close_exch_unadj , t1.blbg_tckr , t1.isin_cd , t1.currency , t1.hangsa_ga , t1.bid , t1.ask , t1.time_ga , t1.tvol , t1.tamt , t1.shar , t1.tomv , t1.t_rate , t1.trd_to_date , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'iw') AS week FROM SYT0LP t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), -12) AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.jm_cd = #{jmCd} ORDER BY t1.ymd DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{exprDate}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'w') = '3' THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{exprDate}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'w') END || #{blbgTckr} || SRS_MM || SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{exprDate}, '-', ''), 3, 2) || NVL(#{isCallPut}, '') || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(#{stkprc})) FROM SZX0YM t1 WHERE t1.YMD_GB = 'M' AND t1.YMD_ID = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{exprDate}, '-', ''), 5, 2) AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SRS_CD WHERE SRS_CD = COALESCE(#{origSrsCd}, #{srsCd})
